import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import itertools

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        A = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        found = False
        for B in itertools.permutations(A):
            B = list(B)
            for C in itertools.permutations(A):
                C = list(C)
                if all(sorted(B[i:j]) != sorted(C[i:j]) for i in range(1, N) for j in range(i, N) if (i, j) != (1, N)):
                    found = True
                    results.append("YES")
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, B)))
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, C)))
                    break
            if found:
                break
        if not found:
            results.append("NO")
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
